head_commit.message: Synchronize five WMS rule archives with reviewed Init contract

steps.name: Install locked dependencies without lifecycle scripts
Per-game rule archive matches committed implementation
Fixed offline checks with joined results and bounded concurrency
Seal Linux preparation evidence for the independent local admission workers
Deliver ciphertext only; no raw game records or credentials
